newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIA'S EQUITY MARKET UP 1.3 PERCENT.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIA'S EQUITY MARKET UP 1.3 PERCENT.

text.p: Romania's equity market put on a better performance on Wednesday, rising 1.3 percent from the previous trading day.

The VAB-General index, a capitalisation-weighted index of the Bucharest stock exchange and Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market, was 8.3 percent up on the week on Wednesday, according to VANGUARD securities, which computes the unofficial index.
Bucharest bourse shares traded mixed. Two first-tier stocks -- Oltchim chemical plant and fertiliser maker Azomures -- dominated trading and took the bulk of 5.2 billion lei turnover.
Nine of the exchange's 29 stocks drifted higher, 10 slipped and two stayed flat. Six stocks had no trade and two companies remained suspended.
Policolor fertiliser maker was the most active on the second tier.
The VAB index for the bourse stood at 533 points, 2.3 percent up on Tuesday and 11.5 percent up on the week.
The RASDAQ, Romania's OTC market, showed 2.63 million shares in traded volume -- slightly down from the previous session -- on turnover of 5.4 billion lei -- some 38 million up on Tuesday.

The system, which lists more than 2,700 companies, traded 434 stocks on Wednesday, with 126 going up, 174 sliding and 134 unchanged. The VAB-Rasdaq index rose 8.0 percent on the week to 2,169.6 points.
Wednesday's RASDAQ star performers were cement maker Casial, which traded 484,132 shares and hotelier Bucovina Turism, in which 142,152 shares changed hands.
Casial closed 10 lei weaker at 920, while Bucovina, which did not trade on Monday and Tuesday, fell 100 lei to 100.
